a.speaker: narrator
a.text: Red emergency lights sweep across blast doors and bulletproof glass. The Security Deck smells of ozone and scorched metal.

b.speaker: halcyon
b.text: Warning: atmospheric breach in the lift lobby. Bridge lockdown active by order of Chief Marcus Dray.

c.speaker: bolt
c.text: Dray's deck. His robots are still running his last orders: burn everything that glows. I glow, Kai. A little.

d.speaker: bolt
d.text: We need to override the lockdown at the command gate, north. And let's patch that breach first.

a.speaker: bolt
a.text: Security bots are armored against wrenches and bullets. Use EMP, hack them, or switch to the cutter. And Scan first!

a.speaker: narrator
a.text: Behind the bars of a holding cell, a woman in a security uniform sits against the wall. Bloom spots crawl up her arm. She looks up, hollow-eyed.

b.speaker: tanaka
b.name: Officer Tanaka
b.text: You're not one of Dray's. Good. I'm Officer Tanaka. I'm in here because I finally said no. Too late.

c.speaker: tanaka
c.name: Officer Tanaka
c.text: You'll need the armory to get past WARDOG. Here. My keycard.

d.speaker: tanaka
d.name: Officer Tanaka
d.text: WARDOG guards the command gate. It has a shield matrix. Your drone can crack it with an intrusion suite. After that, EMP hurts it.

e.speaker: tanaka
e.name: Officer Tanaka
e.text: I'm infected. If you have a serum, I'd like to live long enough to apologize to the Captain.

again.speaker: tanaka
again.name: Officer Tanaka
again.text: Still here. Did the keycard work?

ask.speaker: tanaka
ask.name: Officer Tanaka
ask.text: Whatever you decide, I won't blame you.

choices.text: Give her a serum and get her out (1h 30m)

saved.speaker: tanaka
saved.name: Officer Tanaka
saved.text: Thank you. Take these grenades. And one more thing: Dray kept a spare keycard in the barracks, under his bunk. Whatever he hid in his office is still there.

b.speaker: bolt
b.text: Point it at the bad guys, not at me. I say that with love.

c.speaker: narrator
c.name: New weapon
c.text: PULSE RIFLE: kinetic damage with a high critical rate. Deadly against infected flesh, weak against armor.

a.speaker: bolt
a.text: Repair nanites! Now I can patch you up mid-battle. I'm basically a doctor now. Doctor BOLT.

b.speaker: narrator
b.name: New ability
b.text: BOLT learned REPAIR: restores 35% of Kai's HP.

a.speaker: narrator
a.text: The command gate is guarded by WARDOG: a four-legged riot mech bristling with guns, its shield matrix shimmering blue.

b.speaker: halcyon
b.name: WARDOG
b.text: UNAUTHORIZED PERSONNEL. BLOOM CONTAMINATION DETECTED. PURGE AUTHORIZED.

c.speaker: bolt
c.text: It thinks we're contaminated! ...Okay, we are, a little. That shield blocks most of our damage. Let me HACK it down!

a.speaker: narrator
a.text: WARDOG staggers, sparks pouring from its joints, and collapses in a heap of armor.

b.speaker: bolt
b.text: Good dog. Bad dog. Sleeping dog.

a.speaker: narrator
a.text: The lockdown override. Chief Dray's authorization is wrapped in a dozen redundant locks. BOLT can brute-force them, but it will take a while.

b.speaker: halcyon
b.text: Bridge lockdown lifted. Lift access restored. Captain Voss's command codes remain... unresponsive.

done.speaker: narrator
done.text: The lockdown is lifted. The bridge lift is open.

off.speaker: halcyon
off.text: Bridge lift sealed. Lockdown authority: Chief Marcus Dray.

a.speaker: halcyon
a.text: Lift to the Bridge ready. This is the last deck, Engineer Reyes. Whatever waits up there, you will face it with {time} remaining.
